name: CodeBlock
description:
A fenced code block: language label, copy (✓ in place), wrap toggle and optional line
numbers. Long blocks show their first lines with "Show all n lines". Highlighting loads
lazily; until then the same text renders in the same monospace lines, so nothing moves
when the colours arrive.
signature: ({ code, language, title, label: accessibleLabel, headingLevel, lineNumbers, wrap: initialWrap, maxLines, className, }: CodeBlockProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: code
props.description: Source code displayed by the code block.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level in the surrounding document. Defaults to 3.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; distinguish blocks with the same visible title.

props.name: language
props.description: Fence language ("powershell", "ps1", "json"…). Unknown languages render plain.

props.name: lineNumbers
props.description: Shows line numbers beside the code.

props.name: maxLines
props.description: Lines before the block collapses; 0 never collapses.

props.name: title
props.description: A title in place of the language label ("Clear-PrintQueue.ps1").

props.name: wrap
props.description: Start wrapped (logs, long one-liners). The reader can toggle it.
